serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I need to turn them against each other, but how?
Oh! This could work!
A normal bribe would just raise their morale and they would come back later demanding more but if I can use their greed against them…
I think I’m actually starting to think like the Landlord…
You: There’s around ten of you guys, right?
Hobo: Yeah, what about it? You aren’t seriously planning on kicking us out, right? Give up, it’s impossible!
You: Hm, I don’t know about that. 
You: The first person to leave will get 2000$. Every next person will get half of the sum that was given before. So it will go like this: 2000$, 1000$, 500$, 250$, 125$, 60$... You get the idea, right? 
You: So. How will it be?
#Hobo.Face.smug
Hobo: Are you kidding me? That’s your plan?  Do you seriously think that-
#Hobo.Face.scared
???1: I will take it!
